sources.entry: PyQt6 - Python bindings for the Qt cross-platform application and UI framework.

summary.name: PyQt6
summary.one_liner: PyQt6 is a set of Python bindings for the Qt cross-platform application and UI framework, documented in this reference guide.
use_cases: building cross-platform desktop GUI applications in Python
migrating existing PyQt5 code to PyQt6
using Qt Designer forms in Python projects
summary.what_it_does: The page is the reference guide index for PyQt6, listing its documentation sections. Topics include installation, differences between PyQt6 and PyQt5, support for signals and slots, Qt properties, Qt interfaces, QVariant and QSettings, and integration with QML. It also covers Qt Designer use, pickling, using PyQt6 from the Python shell, internationalisation, DBus support, and the PyQt6 Extension API. The text shown is only the table of contents, so the details of each section are not included.
notable: Python bindings for the Qt 6 framework
Includes QML integration and Qt Designer support
Supports DBus and the PyQt6 Extension API
caveats: Page text is only a table of contents; no platform or licensing details shown
